note: Åland: Finland's Aliens Act (301/2004) applies there, and from 2025 the Finnish Immigration Service decides residence permits for employed persons without a partial decision from the employment authorities, on Åland's own guidelines for foreign labour (Government of Åland, decision of 7 January 2025). EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). As for Finland, the Act's work without a permit for invited artists couldn't be read and isn't modelled. Short engagement corrected 2026-11-01 from the permit research (papers.permits.AX): professional artists and film workers may work up to 90 days without a permit.

sources.title: Ålands landskapsregering, protokoll nr 1 (7.1.2025): Riktlinjer för anlitandet av utländsk arbetskraft på Åland
sources.said: Riktlinjerna för anlitandet av utländsk arbetskraft baserar sig på utlänningslagen (FFS 301/2004). Från och med ingången av 2025 fattar Migrationsverket beslut om beviljande av uppehållstillstånd för arbetstagare, utan delbeslut från arbetskraftsmyndigheter.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Travel to Finland for work
sources.said: The following may not require a visa or permit in Finland if they’re for up to 90 days and require special expertise: specialists interpreters teachers sport judges or referees professional artists, coaches or athletes film workers whose employers do not have an office in Finland
